about.title: Building reliable software for real businesses
about.body: Frontend Developer with 2+ years of experience building enterprise logistics and B2B SaaS applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Passionate about building fast, scalable, and user-friendly web applications. Skilled in building reusable UI components, high-performance data grids, and large dynamic forms, while working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver maintainable software.

experience.title: Experience
experience.description: Where I've worked and what I've shipped.
experience.roleIntro: As the sole frontend engineer responsible for developing the company's three core products — serving 200+ internal users — I owned everything from screen architecture design and component development to performance optimization for large-scale data systems.

tms-container.title: Apollogix TMS Container
tms-container.subtitle: Enterprise Transport Management System
tms-container.problem: Operations staff needed to track hundreds of daily trips at once — drivers, containers, vehicles, routes, and idle time — but the data was scattered across multiple screens, making real-time coordination difficult.
solution: Designed and built a unified transport timeline view, accurate to the minute, on a single screen.
Leveraged advanced AG Grid features — pinned columns, custom cell renderers, column groups, column spans, and value getters — to present multi-dimensional data.
Built transport job forms with 50+ dynamic fields using React Hook Form and Yup, with validation tailored to each business case.
Implemented data tables handling 15,000+ routing records with infinite scrolling, server-side filtering, pagination, and Excel export.
Managed all server state with TanStack Query — caching, query persistence, infinite queries, and mutation invalidation — significantly cutting redundant API calls.
tms-container.result: Operators can now track and coordinate every trip of the day from a single screen instead of multiple disconnected systems, shortening dispatch decision time.

fms.title: Apollogix FMS
fms.subtitle: Freight Forwarding & Cost Control Platform
fms.problem: The platform needed to manage 15,000+ freight cost records and complex shipment-consolidation workflows, while page performance suffered from unnecessary re-renders.
solution: Developed core logistics features serving 200+ internal users and processing 15,000+ freight cost records.
Identified and eliminated the causes of excessive re-renders, optimizing the data-fetching strategy to improve page responsiveness.
Built shipment and consolidation forms with 70+ fields and complex validation logic.
Developed inline-editable AG Grid tables for large-scale logistics operations.
fms.result: Page responsiveness improved noticeably for high-volume data operations, letting operations staff work faster and more accurately on high-volume orders.

workspace.title: Apollogix Workspace
workspace.subtitle: B2B Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform
workspace.problem: The company needed a shared SaaS platform for multiple enterprise customers (multi-tenant), built from scratch with an automated deployment pipeline.
solution: Built the entire frontend platform from project setup to production using Next.js.
Implemented multi-tenant authentication, workspace management, and vendor management.
Configured Docker and GitHub Actions to automate the deployment and release process.
workspace.result: The platform runs stably with an automated deployment pipeline, shortening release time and reducing manual deployment errors.
